title: PendingDoseConfirmation carries the chosen notifyOnNextDose value
description: The 'too soon, log anyway?' confirmation path needs to remember the user's notify-on-next-dose choice from the original dialog submission so it can be passed through when they confirm.
acceptance_criteria: PendingDoseConfirmation gains a new field: val notifyOnNextDose: Boolean
The existing four fields (profileId, medicationId, doseAmount, minutesRemaining) are unchanged
exact_code:
private data class PendingDoseConfirmation(
    val profileId: Int,
    val medicationId: Int,
    val doseAmount: String,
    val minutesRemaining: Long,
    val notifyOnNextDose: Boolean,
)
